document.summary: `[` `]` walk `dependsOn` order inside the current part, including Overview at the start of that walk. `{` `}` hop independent parts. Depends on and Needed by stay click hops. The group-page pager is gone.

commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The header pager from #73 stays the only group chrome. [ and ] walk dependsOn order inside one part and stop at the part edge. { and } hop independent parts. Depends on and Needed by stay click hops. The group-page prev/next bar is gone so it does not compete with the header.
